overview_description.description: Metaphorio is an online collaboration platform designed by video producers for video producers to help them manage their productions efficiently from A to Z. Over the past 5 years, the founders have been running an online video production agency and decided that there had to be a better, simpler, and less time consuming way to manage projects.
